trackgleam_master.notes: Commercial master with makeup gain (+2.8 dB) and brickwall limiter; prominent 8-12 kHz EQ/exciter boost, roll-off above 16 kHz.

basis_restored.description: Full-song 48 kHz stereo restoration via frozen Basis coupled field operator
basis_restored.notes: Exact volume match to OG raw; punchier transient attacks (+0.9 dB crest factor); authentic harmonic and noise air extension through 16-24 kHz.

user_listening_evaluation.verdict: Owner prefers Basis bite and high-band definition for full-song restoration; TrackGleam balance and master loudness are noted.
user_listening_evaluation.qualifications: Owner confirmed Basis restored song feels punchier, highs definitely better, and definition is very good. The slight top-octave bite/scratchiness was preferred over heavy damping to preserve high-band strength.
